SELECT id AS "id", sale_date AS "saleDate", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = sales_record.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = sales_record.product_code) AS "productName", qty AS "qty", unit_price AS "unitPrice", amount AS "amount", note AS "note", source_type AS "sourceType", COALESCE((SELECT emp.name FROM employees emp WHERE emp.id = sales_record.created_by LIMIT 1), sales_record.created_by) AS "createdBy" FROM sales_record WHERE sale_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
AND (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = sales_record.client_code LIMIT 1) ILIKE '%' || #{clientName} || '%'
AND (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = sales_record.product_code) ILIKE '%' || #{productName} || '%'
ORDER BY sale_date, "clientName", "productName", id
